name: What are the financial implications of a sale-leaseback for the seller?

mainEntity.name: What are the financial implications of a sale-leaseback for the seller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financially, a sale-leaseback provides immediate access to your home equity, converting it into liquid assets. You will no longer be responsible for property taxes or homeowner's insurance; these become the buyer's responsibility. However, you will pay rent to the new owner, which can be factored into your financial planning. Understanding your cash flow needs and the proposed rental rate is crucial, and we can help analyze how this compares to maintaining ownership costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sale-leaseback frees up home equity but requires you to pay rent to the new owner, shifting property tax and insurance responsibilities.
